name: auth
description: JWT auth with email whitelist, session management, and cross-subdomain SSO

docs.usage: Auth is enforced via Next.js middleware. Users log in with email magic links. Only emails in ALLOWED_EMAILS can access the app.
docs.whitelist: Set ALLOWED_EMAILS as comma-separated list. ADMIN_EMAIL receives login notifications.
docs.sessions: Sessions last 90 days (sliding window). Revoke by deleting the row in Neon console.
docs.sso: JWT cookie is set on .scottzockoll.com — all subdomain apps share auth automatically.
docs.imports: import { requireAuth } from '@/lib/auth'; // in API routes/server actions: const user = await requireAuth();
